Assistant Request
operations.description: Fires before the call is connected when the receiving phone number has `server.url` configured. Your endpoint **must** respond within `server.timeoutSeconds` (default 7s, max 7s) with one of the supported response shapes — see the response schema for the union of valid replies. The body is signed with HMAC-SHA256 in the `X-Webhook-Signature` header when a signing secret is configured on the phone number.

operations.title: Status Update
operations.description: Call lifecycle transition (queued → ringing → in-progress → ended). When the call is in-progress, `call.monitor` carries live-monitoring URLs. Fire-and-forget; one retry on 5xx with 200ms backoff. Subscribe via `assistant.webhookEvents` containing `status-update`.

operations.title: Transcript
operations.description: Final or partial transcript chunk for a single utterance. Use `isFinal` to distinguish stable transcripts from streaming partials. Subscribe via `assistant.webhookEvents`.

operations.title: End of Call Report
operations.description: Post-call snapshot fired once per call after analysis and recording split finish. The most important event for downstream systems — persist transcripts, archive recordings, push CRM updates, run analytics. Subscribe via `assistant.webhookEvents` containing `end-of-call-report`.

operations.title: Tool Function Call
operations.description: Per-invocation HTTP call to the **tool's own** `server.url` — fires every time the LLM picks a function tool. **Sync mode** (`async = false`): the LLM blocks on your response and forwards your reply as the tool result. **Async mode** (`async = true`): fire-and-forget — the LLM sees `{"async": true}` immediately; your reply (if any) is discarded. Custom headers configured on `tool.server.headers` are merged into every request.

operations.title: Chat Session Status Update
operations.description: Fires when a chat session is created and again when it ends (closed, expired, or errored) — `event` says which. Delivered to the assistant's `server.url`; subscribe via `assistant.webhookEvents` containing `chat-session-status-update`. Signed with HMAC-SHA256 in `X-Webhook-Signature` (`sha256=<hex>` over the raw body) when `server.secret` is set.

operations.title: Chat Message
operations.description: Fires after every completed assistant turn — and when an operator injects a hidden message (`message.source = "operator-inject"`). Delivered to the assistant's `server.url`; subscribe via `assistant.webhookEvents` containing `chat-message`. Signed with HMAC-SHA256 in `X-Webhook-Signature`.

operations.title: Chat Session End Report
operations.description: The canonical conversation-finished record — delivered once the post-session pipeline (analysis, anonymization) completes, and **before** any zero-day retention purge, so this payload is your durable copy. Subscribe via `assistant.webhookEvents` containing `chat-session-end-report`. Signed with HMAC-SHA256 in `X-Webhook-Signature`. Delivery failures re-queue the job (up to 3 attempts) — dedupe on `id`.

operations.title: Widget Message Incoming
operations.description: One POST per visitor message to the widget's `incomingMessageWebhookUrl` — your endpoint is the widget's brain. Headers: `X-AgenticFlow-Signature-256` (`sha256=<hex>` HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body with the widget's webhook secret), `X-AgenticFlow-Event: widget.message.incoming`, `X-AgenticFlow-Delivery` (dedupe key), `X-AgenticFlow-Timestamp`.

operations.title: Widget Audit Event
operations.description: Write-only event mirror delivered to each configured audit-webhook endpoint (separate from the reply webhook). An empty subscription list on the endpoint subscribes to **all** events. Signed per endpoint with `X-AgenticFlow-Signature-256` over the raw body using that endpoint's own `whsec_…` secret. Delivery is at-least-once — dedupe on `id`.

operations.title: Message Received
operations.description: An inbound message arrived on a channel. `messageType` selects which content fields are populated (`text`, `media` with a signed 24h `downloadUrl`, `location`, `contactVcard`, `interactive`, inbound-email `subject`). WhatsApp events carry the 24h window state so you can branch without a follow-up call. Delivered to the channel's `webhookUrl`. Headers: `X-Webhook-Signature` (`t=<unix_ts>,v1=<hex>` — HMAC-SHA256 over `v1:{timestamp}:{raw_body}` with the channel's signing secret; reject stale timestamps, ~5 min tolerance), `X-Webhook-Event-Id` (dedupe key), `X-Webhook-Event-Type`, `X-Webhook-Channel-Id`, `User-Agent: MessagingWebhook/1.0`. Respond `2xx` within 10 seconds. Retries: +30s, +2m, +10m, +1h (5 attempts total); after 25 consecutive permanent failures the URL is auto-disabled. Delivery is at-least-once and unordered — dedupe on `eventId`, order by `occurredAt`. The envelope is identical for every event type; inapplicable fields are `null`.

operations.title: Status Changed
operations.description: An outbound message advanced — `newStatus` is `sent`, `delivered`, or `read` (there are no separate per-status events, and statuses never downgrade). Delivered to the channel's `webhookUrl`. Headers: `X-Webhook-Signature` (`t=<unix_ts>,v1=<hex>` — HMAC-SHA256 over `v1:{timestamp}:{raw_body}` with the channel's signing secret; reject stale timestamps, ~5 min tolerance), `X-Webhook-Event-Id` (dedupe key), `X-Webhook-Event-Type`, `X-Webhook-Channel-Id`, `User-Agent: MessagingWebhook/1.0`. Respond `2xx` within 10 seconds. Retries: +30s, +2m, +10m, +1h (5 attempts total); after 25 consecutive permanent failures the URL is auto-disabled. Delivery is at-least-once and unordered — dedupe on `eventId`, order by `occurredAt`. The envelope is identical for every event type; inapplicable fields are `null`.

operations.title: Message Failed
operations.description: An outbound message permanently failed — `failureReason` carries the provider's verbatim reason (e.g. "recipient not on WhatsApp", "template not approved"). Failed messages are not retried by the platform. Delivered to the channel's `webhookUrl`. Headers: `X-Webhook-Signature` (`t=<unix_ts>,v1=<hex>` — HMAC-SHA256 over `v1:{timestamp}:{raw_body}` with the channel's signing secret; reject stale timestamps, ~5 min tolerance), `X-Webhook-Event-Id` (dedupe key), `X-Webhook-Event-Type`, `X-Webhook-Channel-Id`, `User-Agent: MessagingWebhook/1.0`. Respond `2xx` within 10 seconds. Retries: +30s, +2m, +10m, +1h (5 attempts total); after 25 consecutive permanent failures the URL is auto-disabled. Delivery is at-least-once and unordered — dedupe on `eventId`, order by `occurredAt`. The envelope is identical for every event type; inapplicable fields are `null`.

operations.title: Reaction Added
operations.description: Someone reacted to one of your messages — `reactionEmoji` plus `reactionTargetMessageId` (the provider id of the message that was reacted to).
